sources.title: Csordas, Fourier transforms of positive definite kernels and the Riemann xi-function (2014)
sources.use: Sections 3–4: autocorrelation positive definiteness and the associated-kernel hierarchy are prior art. Our completion/polarization is an elementary audit, not a new criterion.

sources.title: Planat, A Theta-Kernel Reformulation of Riemann-Xi Growth and the Obstruction to Blockwise Positivity (2026)
sources.access: Indexed primary-source abstract and sections; direct full-page requests returned 429.
sources.use: Additional overlap screen: growth representation and a reported obstruction to a particular phase-aligned block decomposition. Not a proof dependency; not identified with the NS100 fixed-p slice test.

sources.title: Planat, Nonlocal Cancellation in a Theta-Kernel Decomposition of the Riemann Xi-Growth Derivative (preprint, 2026)
sources.use: Primary preprint text inspected for scope. It reports cancellation and failure of universal positivity in its phase-aligned blocks, while leaving correlated groupings/resummation open. No full proof audit or numerical replay performed, and none of its exclusion claims is imported as a new repository theorem.

novelty: No worldwide novelty claimed for the elementary paired-dilation control or identities. NS100 literature screen was explicitly nonexhaustive; this adds omitted recent overlap without revising its archived files.
